nodes.label: DB-001: Identify Doctrine Entities
nodes.rationale: Read-only prerequisite inventory step; DB-002/003/004 all declare a dependency on it rather than re-implementing entity discovery. Doc flags that 'MySQL 8.15' isn't a real MySQL release string (point releases only go up to 8.0.46 / next LTS 8.4), so the profile's stated MySQL version needs human confirmation.

nodes.label: DB-002: Create Doctrine Entity
nodes.rationale: Deliberately avoids PHP 8.0+ features (constructor property promotion, readonly properties) because this adapter targets Symfony 4.4's PHP ^7.1.3 constraint, even though such features would otherwise be idiomatic for new entity code.

nodes.label: DB-003: Update Doctrine Entity
nodes.rationale: Deliberately non-destructive: rejects field narrowing, removal, or relation removal so that a targeted edit capability can never silently produce a destructive schema change; that concern is pushed to DB-004's diff-review step instead.

nodes.label: DB-004: Create Doctrine Migration
nodes.rationale: Requires config/packages/doctrine.yaml to explicitly pin dbal.default_table_options.charset/collation to utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci because Doctrine DBAL's own default (utf8mb4_unicode_ci) diverges from what MySQL 8.0+ actually creates by default — without the pin, every diff run generates spurious COLLATE noise unrelated to real entity changes. Also never executes generated migrations; execution is a separate human-approved step per security_constraints.
